description: SYNTHETIC agent-memory task, written 2026-10-12 by an AI assistant (no notes ship in the repo). Documents are short Preference/Context notes in the style of AGENT_MEMORY_GUIDE.md, with deliberate near-miss distractors. Queries are the user's next message, which is what FindSimilarAgentNotes embeds; 'relevant' are the notes an agent should inject.

documents.text: User prefers summaries presented as bullet points rather than paragraphs.
User strongly prefers gauge charts for tracking KPIs.
User prefers bar charts over pie charts for comparing categories.
User works in the Eastern time zone; schedule meetings between 9am and 4pm ET.
The finance team closes the books on the third business day of each month.
User's fiscal year starts on July 1.
Always address the executive director as Dr. Patel in drafted emails.
User wants revenue figures rounded to the nearest thousand dollars.
Membership renewals are due on the member's join anniversary, not on January 1.
The annual conference is held every October in Denver.
User prefers British spelling (colour, organisation) in written content.
User dislikes emoji in professional communications.
Company brand colours are navy blue and gold; avoid red in charts.
User's preferred report format is a one-page PDF.
Board meetings happen on the second Tuesday of each quarter.
User is vegetarian; choose vegetarian options when ordering catering.
The CRM of record is Salesforce; HubSpot is only used by marketing.
User wants SQL examples written for SQL Server, not PostgreSQL.
Data exports should be CSV with UTF-8 encoding and a header row.
User prefers concise answers with no more than three sentences unless asked for detail.
The volunteer coordinator is Maria Gomez; route volunteer questions to her.
Student members receive a 50 percent discount on dues.
User's team uses Microsoft Teams, not Slack, for chat notifications.
User wants dates formatted as day/month/year.
Grant reports are due to the foundation by March 31 each year.
User is colour-blind (red-green); use high-contrast palettes in visuals.
Event registrations close 48 hours before the event starts.
User prefers tables over charts when comparing fewer than five numbers.
The organization's legal name is the North American Society of Hydrologists.
User wants a short executive summary at the top of every long report.
Newsletter goes out every Thursday morning at 8am.
User does not want weekend work scheduled for the support staff.
Chapter leaders should be copied on emails about events in their region.
User prefers line charts for showing trends over time.
Amounts should be shown in Canadian dollars for the Toronto chapter.
Donations over $10,000 require a personal thank-you call from the CEO.
User is the membership director and owns the renewal campaign.
Use the formal 'you' register when drafting messages in German or French.
The website runs on WordPress; landing page changes go through the web team.
User likes code samples in TypeScript with strict typing.
